beats.headline: Eighth on the board
beats.text: The board does the introductions this dungeon never bothers with. Ifechi is eighth: human, a Physicker, level eighteen. Healing is a class down here and a liability at the same time, since the one thing nobody in this place will let you do is keep other people alive. Note it and move on. The audience already has.

beats.headline: One of the handful the show follows
beats.text: The recap presents the top ten one at a time, a short clip each, and she is in it: Elle, Li Jun's team, Ifechi, the cat and the man, Florin, Prepotente, Hekla, and the girl who is hunting the cat. Ifechi travels with Florin now. Being in the running order is not the same as being safe in it. It is nearer the opposite, and every one of them has worked that out by now.

beats.headline: Florin's own bullets, turned around
beats.text: Crawler Ifechi is dead. The recap of the previous floor carried it in full: Florin put shell after shell into Lucia Mar, and none of it landed on her. It landed on Ifechi, leaning against the wall, who had spent her protection spells on Florin and on a stranger and kept none for herself. A Red Cross medic, top ten, and by the reunion the recap chose to show, a good deal more than Florin's friend. It ran the whole thing, which is a detail I did not write into the format and cannot take out of it.

beats.headline: The queen has her sister's face
beats.text: Queen Imogen, host of the ball, is Ifechi's twin. Born together in Nigeria. One of them walked into the dungeon with a medical bag over her shoulder; the other one was taken somewhere else entirely and comes back wearing a crown and a boss's level. Carl is at the party working out the resemblance in real time, under a celestial peace seal that feeds whoever breaks it to the Nothing. Enjoy the canapés.
